tool_args.rationale: The responses are close to twice u_now despite changes in past input, memory, and gradient, consistent with the archived adiabatic relaxation mechanism at a long horizon. Fit its parameters numerically and test fresh confirmation before purchasing further observations.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations already cover the target horizon; the two-parameter adiabatic model can be fitted and freshly confirmed first.
The observed responses are nearly proportional to current input, consistent with a damped fast transient; a more complex four-parameter model is not yet needed.
The observations and pilot signatures favor slow relaxation rather than a sink-gradient-dependent branch.
